title: Announcements: choose the page's shape
question: The admin panel's look is settled; this is how the Announcements page is put together. You said the office sends a few a month and writing it well should be easiest. Lock one, steer it, or ask for another hand. (The inbox on the phone comes next on this page.)

options.label: The fortnight ahead
options.thesis: A rail of the next fourteen days shows what's going out; the writing desk sits under it.
options.viewport: Title band, a sand rail of 14 day columns with scheduled and sent capsules, then the writing column beside its lock-screen proof.
options.risk: With a few a month the rail is mostly empty days, and it pushes the writing below the fold on a laptop.

options.label: Written beside its proof
options.thesis: Write in the middle, see it on a real phone on the right, and tick off who and when underneath.
options.viewport: A narrow sand list (Waiting, Scheduled, Sent), a wide writing column, and a phone showing the lock screen and the inbox row as you type.
options.risk: Three panes on a 1280 laptop leave the writing column narrow unless the list folds away.

options.label: A letter and its envelope
options.thesis: Writing gets the whole desk: the envelope (to, when, opens, urgent) sits above the letter.
options.viewport: An envelope strip of four plain choices above a big title and message on a sand sheet; a small lock-screen card in the margin. The list is its own page.
options.risk: The list and the writing are two pages, so checking an earlier announcement means leaving the one you're writing.
